chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, both together, from Usman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked him (peace be upon him) about the divorce of a pregnant woman, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'One [divorce], and her term is that she places her load (gives birth)'.

key_terms.تَضَعُ حَمْلَهَا: She gives birth / places her load

ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a pregnant woman after divorce according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi, transmitted through the chain of Samaanah, establishes the primary Quranic basis for the 'iddah of a pregnant woman, confirming that her waiting period concludes upon the delivery of the child. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling is considered definitive and distinct from the 'iddah of non-pregnant women, serving as a key evidence for the principle that pregnancy overrides other criteria for determining the duration of the waiting period.
